seeds.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN buyer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id), 0) FROM (SELECT buyer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sub_order_id) AS cnt FROM v_order_paid WHERE pay_time >= '2026-06-01' GROUP BY buyer_id)
seeds.notes: 窗口固定 90 天、不含首单口径；含子查询 → c2=1
